title: Rees Atkins
text:
I am a first-year Ph.D. student in the Department of Political Science at Florida State University. I study American politics and policy, with a focus on immigration.
Before starting my Ph.D. at FSU, I earned a J.D. at Arizona State University and a B.S. in economics at Brigham Young University. Past experience practicing criminal and immigration law contributes to the interest in my research.

title: Research
text: My research examines how citizens form and change their political opinions. A complete list is on my CV.
